text: At N=256, accel_step forms (step 100-120) while val_mse_ratio is still about 87-98 and never falls below 11. Is the accel_step margin driven by the training data, or by the gradient early in training regardless of task difficulty? Would a model trained on shuffled-time sequences (no dynamics to learn) still develop a 0.1 accel_step margin at about step 100?
